_README: ManakSetu controlled standards catalogue.
VERIFICATION RULE: a record may only carry verification_status 'verified' when
standard_number, official_title, official_source_url, source_organisation and
last_checked_date are all filled in from an official BIS source, and a human has
checked them. Anything else stays 'demo' and MUST have standard_number null, so
the interface renders it as an unverified record that cannot be cited.
TO ADD A REAL STANDARD: set standard_number (e.g. 'IS 4151:2015'), official_title
exactly as published, official_source_url to the BIS catalogue page, fill
retrieved_date and last_checked_date, then change verification_status to
'verified'. Re-run the seed; the content hash and embedding regenerate.
relationships: edges to other records in this file, by 'key'. Types are
references | tested_by | safety | installation | terminology.
VERSION FIELDS: status is current | revised | withdrawn | uncertain.
superseded_by names another record's key; set it together with a status of
revised or withdrawn. amendments is a list of {amendment_number, issued_date,
summary, official_source_url, verification_status}. An amendment may only be
marked verified when its own official source is recorded.
TIERS: verified = a person has checked the record against the official BIS
entry. pending = imported from an official BIS page, identifier shown but not
yet confirmed by a person. demo = illustrative only, carries no identifier.
Records imported on 2026-09-16 from the BIS Scheme-I list and QCO pages are
'pending': confirm each title and year against lims.bis.gov.in, set
last_checked_date, then promote to 'verified'.
